cases.verification_purpose: held-out incidence near stall (Ladson, tripped, 15 degrees)

cases.independence_evidence: NASA FAITH experiment (Bell, Heineck, Zilliac, Mehta and Long; NASA Ames), an axisymmetric cosine hill of height H = 0.1524 m at Re_H = 5e5: a geometry, facility and measurement campaign unrelated to every development case. No FORGE v2 or V3 search or selection step evaluated it; the only earlier use was a FORGE v1 Phase-4 holdout run of stock SST and v1 candidates, which none of the V3 inputs were chosen from.

reference.qualification: Verification use; inflow boundary layer not matched to the tunnel; FISF skin-friction magnitude not used (normalisation unresolved), only the measured separation and reattachment positions
reference.amendment: Reattachment x/H = 1.78, where the reversed near-wall flow of the centerline PIV plane ends, as in the paper; the frozen verification scorer used 1.72, the zero crossing of the measured surface friction.

metrics.name: velocity_rmse
metrics.normalization: Hypot of RMS u and v errors at the PIV points of the symmetry plane, each over U_ref = 49.68 m/s

metrics.name: separation_position_error
metrics.normalization: Absolute difference of the centreline separation position from the measured 0.38 H; a missing bubble is charged the measured bubble length 1.34 H

metrics.name: reattachment_position_error
metrics.normalization: Absolute difference of the centreline reattachment position from the measured 1.72 H; a missing bubble is charged the measured bubble length 1.34 H

cases.verification_purpose: held-out 3D bluff body: attached-then-separating 25 degree slant
cases.independence_evidence: Lienhart and Becker (LSTM Erlangen, 2003; ERCOFTAC case 82) measurements on the Ahmed body: a bluff road-vehicle geometry, facility and measurement campaign unrelated to every development case, never evaluated by FORGE v1, v2 or V3.

reference.qualification: Verification use; wall functions on body, stilts and floor (not the resolved walls of the development cases); uniform inflow instead of the measured profile; stilt positions from the usual reading of the original drawing

metrics.name: slant_velocity_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS vector error at the LDA points of the planes y = 0, 100, 180 mm over the slant and in the near wake, over U = 40 m/s

metrics.name: wake_velocity_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS vector error at the LDA points of the cross planes x = 0, 80, 200, 500 mm behind the body (mirrored onto the half model), over U = 40 m/s

metrics.name: rear_pressure_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS difference of the pressure coefficient at the rear-surface taps (slant and base); reference pressure the upstream free stream

cases.verification_purpose: held-out 3D bluff body: fully separated 35 degree slant
cases.independence_evidence: Lienhart and Becker (LSTM Erlangen, 2003; ERCOFTAC case 82) measurements on the Ahmed body: a bluff road-vehicle geometry, facility and measurement campaign unrelated to every development case, never evaluated by FORGE v1, v2 or V3.

reference.qualification: Verification use; wall functions on body, stilts and floor (not the resolved walls of the development cases); uniform inflow instead of the measured profile; stilt positions from the usual reading of the original drawing

metrics.name: slant_velocity_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS vector error at the LDA points of the planes y = 0, 100, 180 mm over the slant and in the near wake, over U = 40 m/s

metrics.name: wake_velocity_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS vector error at the LDA points of the cross planes x = 0, 80, 200, 500 mm behind the body (mirrored onto the half model), over U = 40 m/s

metrics.name: rear_pressure_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS difference of the pressure coefficient at the rear-surface taps (slant and base); reference pressure the upstream free stream

cases.verification_purpose: held-out 3D flow: separation in an asymmetric 3D diffuser
cases.independence_evidence: Stanford three-dimensional asymmetric diffuser (Cherry, Elkins and Eaton 2008, magnetic-resonance velocimetry; ERCOFTAC UFR 4-16): a geometry, facility and measurement campaign unrelated to every development case, never evaluated by FORGE v1, v2 or V3.

reference.qualification: Verification use; Outlet contraction replaced by a straight extension; inflow by a mapped (recycled) inlet duct instead of the 63-height development channel

metrics.name: velocity_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS vector error at the MRV points inside the diffuser (1.5 mm wall margin, stride 2), over U_b = 1 m/s

metrics.name: backflow_fraction_error
metrics.normalization: Absolute difference of the fraction of scored points with reversed streamwise velocity

metrics.name: wall_pressure_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS difference of Cp along the bottom-wall centre line, both referred to the first tap

cases.verification_purpose: held-out 3D flow: horseshoe vortex at a wing-body junction
cases.independence_evidence: Devenport and Simpson (1990) and Fleming et al. (1993) wing-body junction (Virginia Tech; ERCOFTAC case 008): a junction/horseshoe-vortex flow, geometry and facility unrelated to every development case, never evaluated by FORGE v1, v2 or V3.

reference.qualification: Verification use; Trailing edge closed and rounded (1 mm), chord 302 mm instead of 305 mm; data of the other studies in the case (different inflow layers) not used

metrics.name: symmetry_plane_velocity_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS (U, V)/U_ref error of the laser profiles ahead of the wing

metrics.name: crossflow_velocity_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS velocity/U_ref error on the cross planes x/C = 0.18-1.5 (components measured at each point)

metrics.name: wall_pressure_rmse
metrics.normalization: RMS Cp difference on the floor and wing taps (27.6 m/s set), free-stream static reference

contract.name: FORGE V3 verification contract 001
contract.status: Development defaults unchanged; settings added only for the new FAITH metrics
contract.uncertainty: Conservative paired temporal sensitivity envelopes; reference and grid uncertainty remain separate release requirements

improvement.eligibility_rule: Freeze from qualified SST before candidate selection: at least one primary reference error exceeds three times its temporal sensitivity and the preset floor

release_requirements: All required numerical and component checks
Fresh no-feedback confirmation of one frozen winner
contract.airfoil_control_scope: Required NACA surface protection, separate from full-field convergence; not an accuracy or release claim. Two cold SST endpoints must agree before freezing controls.
